title: James
author: James, traditionally understood as the brother of the Lord.
audience: The twelve tribes in the Dispersion, Jewish Christian believers.
historicalSetting: James calls believers to practical faith shown in endurance, speech, humility, wisdom, and obedience.
keyVerse: James 1:22 — "But be doers of the word, and not only hearers."
christFocus: James points to Christ by calling believers to a living faith that bears fruit through obedience, mercy, and humble dependence on God.
